default.notes: Apply for the Nigeria e-Visa online before travel (launched May 2025, replacing visa on arrival) — decisions normally within 48 hours. A small number of nationalities must still apply through a Nigerian embassy; verify eligibility on the official portal.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter Nigeria without a visa under the bloc's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days.

NG.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Nigerian citizens.
